archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) with an elegant editorial twist
mood: Sentimental, warm, tactile, high emotional impact

headings.usage: Hero headers, card titles, and high-impact emotional statements. Use tracking-tight for sizes above 32px.

body.usage: Interface elements, buttons, standard text. Gives a modern, clean contrast to the serif headings.

background.description: Warm Pearl / Alabaster. Replaces standard white to reduce eye strain and feel like premium paper.

foreground.description: Deep Pine / Forest Green. Used for all primary text instead of black for a softer, organic contrast.

primary.description: Terracotta / Warm Rose. Used for primary CTAs like 'Create Card' or 'Share'.

secondary.description: Soft Peach. Used for secondary buttons, tool active states, and soft backgrounds.

accent.description: Pale Sage. Used for highlights or decorative elements.

surface.description: Pure white used strictly for the customizable card itself to provide maximum contrast against stickers and photos.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8 to p-24) to create breathing room. The UI should not feel cramped.

editor_layout.grid: Control Room layout tailored for creation.
editor_layout.structure: Sidebar (Tools & Settings: col-span-3) + Canvas Container (col-span-9 bg-background).
editor_layout.canvas: Sticky, centered, with high padding to let the card stand out.

shared_view.layout: Immersive full viewport, center aligned bento-card reveal.
shared_view.background: Soft gradient or abstract floral backdrop, cinematic overlay.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary actions to reinforce the soft archetype. Hover states should lift (-translate-y-1) and cast a warm shadow.
components.inputs: Shadcn standard but with softer borders (border-[#F4E3D7]) and no harsh focus rings. Focus should be a subtle ring of the primary color.
components.card_canvas: Must have a subtle shadow (shadow-xl) and an optional inner border to simulate real card stock. Max-width on mobile to avoid overflow. Ratio typically 5:7.
components.stickers_and_frames: Rendered absolutely positioned inside the card bounds. Implement draggable/resizable if possible, or static placements with customizable coordinates.

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Smooth opacity and slight Y-axis slides via Framer Motion.
motion_and_interactions.reveal_animation: When the shared link is opened, the card should scale up slowly (duration: 1.5s) from 0.9 to 1.0 with a blur filter removing.
motion_and_interactions.particles: Use react-tsparticles for animated confetti and falling flower petals on the reveal page.
motion_and_interactions.music: Implement background music toggler on the shared page (subtle, fade-in HTML5 audio).
motion_and_interactions.editor_feedback: Micro-interactions on clicking stickers/frames, AI generation loading state should use a skeleton or subtle pulsing.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary text (#2C362B) on background (#FDFBF7) exceeds 4.5:1 WCAG.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST use 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., 'data-testid="ai-suggest-button"', 'data-testid="share-card-button"').
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the particle effects on the shared page.

hero_images.description: Mother holding child - emotive portrait for hero landing page.
Woman and girl in floral dress - alternative hero image.

background_textures.description: Watercolor paper texture - use as subtle background for the card element to make it feel tactile.

decorations.description: Elegant floral bouquet - can be used as an overlapping image in the landing page or as a sticker option.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind using the colors defined in this JSON. Update index.css to match the background/foreground.
2. Use 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit' fonts via Google Fonts.
3. Build the Landing Page with high emotional impact: huge serif headings, warm images, overlapping bento shapes.
4. The Editor must have: Image Upload, AI Message Gen, Stickers/Frames logic, and Font/Color pickers. Maintain a beautiful, uncluttered UI.
5. Use framer-motion for UI transitions and react-tsparticles for the final shared card reveal page.
6. MUST include data-testid on every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs).
7. Implement an elegant, slow scale-up reveal animation when the user visits /card/:slug.
